result.reason: The redline does not reach the preferred position and only partially reaches the fallback. Although it limits the restriction to 12 months and adds a performance-based exit, the covered category remains expansive and uncertain because it includes “substantially similar” products and products of unnamed “similar” companies. In addition, the exit terminates only the Company’s obligations, leaving ambiguity as to whether HDI’s separately stated exclusive brand right also terminates. Extending the trigger to any “performance obligation” is broader than the required service-level or delivery-date trigger. Unrelated term and termination-payment provisions are preserved.
